new_events.summary: Reuters summarized the current IAEA-grounded status of Iran's enrichment program: Iran is not currently known to be enriching uranium; the IAEA believes a little more than 200 kg of uranium enriched up to 60% remains, primarily in the Isfahan tunnel complex with some at Natanz; inspectors have not returned to the bombed enrichment sites; and the status of the new Isfahan tunnel enrichment plant remains unknown.

Greek Foreign Minister George Gerapetritis said Greece was willing to cooperate with the United States and offer maritime aid in the Strait of Hormuz if a viable peace process emerges. This was discovered in the recovery sweep after the earlier cutoff; it is a conditional policy offer, not evidence that Greek forces have entered Hormuz operations.

material_results: Late-discovered Greek conditional offer of Hormuz maritime assistance
